papers.title: CLOCs-R: Radar-Assisted Camera-LiDAR Fusion for Long-Range Object Detection
papers.abstract: Long-range 3D object detection remains difficult for autonomous vehicles because LiDAR returns become sparse and camera evidence weakens with distance, while automotive radar keeps returning measurements far beyond both. We present CLOCs-R, an extension of the CLOCs candidate-level fusion framework that adds radar evidence to camera-LiDAR rescoring. Radar returns are accumulated over several sweeps, compensated for ego-motion, and associated with each pre-NMS 3D candidate through a range-dependent gate. Compact features summarizing support, Doppler speed and spread, range residual, and offset are then appended to every camera-LiDAR pair before a lightweight fusion network rescores the candidates. We first verify that our fusion implementation reproduces CLOCs on KITTI. We then evaluate on the daytime clear-weather subset of the aiMotive dataset, reporting distance-binned metrics out to 200 m with frozen SECOND and Cascade R-CNN detectors. Camera-LiDAR CLOCs improves on SECOND up to 50 m but degrades beyond it. A residual scoring variant, introduced post hoc, corrects SECOND's score instead of replacing it and recovers most of this loss. Radar consistently improves BEV AP at 30-50 m (0.857 to 0.870), but beyond 50 m its gain is small (+0.003 center-distance AP), within seed variation, and CLOCs-R with residual scoring is statistically tied with LiDAR-only SECOND. Our analysis attributes the limited long-range benefit to weak separation of true and false detections by radar features, scarce far-range training positives, poor camera evidence at distance, and missing LiDAR proposals that rescoring cannot recover. We report all as-designed and post hoc results side by side.

papers.title: Adaptive Pilot Selection for Unified Semantic Communication and Semantic Sensing in ISAC
papers.abstract: Semantic communication (SemCom) and integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) are promising technologies for future 6G wireless networks. Existing studies have applied semantic technology to either the communication module or the sensing module of ISAC. In this work, we propose SemISAC, which performs both SemCom and semantic sensing within a single dual-function waveform. SemISAC uses a joint semantic encoder that extracts task-specific information for both communication and sensing. We evaluate SemISAC in a vehicular scenario in which vehicles share pixel-wise segmentation of the road environment and, through sensing, classify surrounding objects and estimate their ranges. On the transmitter side, a deep learning encoder converts the input road-scene image into semantic symbols and places them on the data cells of an OFDM grid, while the remaining cells serve as pilots for channel state information estimation and sensing. The pilot configuration is adaptively optimized based on the channel conditions to balance communication and sensing requirements. At the receiver, a deep learning model reconstructs the segmentation from the received waveform, while the transmitting vehicle captures the reflected waveforms from surrounding objects and uses task-specific deep learning decoders for target recognition and range estimation. Simulation results show that SemISAC achieves a segmentation accuracy close to that of the dedicated SemCom module while outperforming both conventional and semantic baselines in target recognition and range estimation.

papers.title: Underwater Visual Target Tracking with Target-Specific Depth Estimation and Adaptive Model-Fusion Predictive Control
papers.abstract: Vision-based underwater target tracking is challenged by unreliable depth measurements and unknown target motion. This paper proposes a stereo visual-servoing framework for an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV). For perception, the framework derives a stable 3D relative state from stereo images through target-specific depth extraction and Kalman filtering. It constructs a target-depth mask from color, disparity, and temporal cues to select reliable target pixels, and then filters the resulting depth measurement and detected image center separately. For control, the framework decouples yaw regulation from translational control, avoiding computationally expensive coupled multi-DOF optimization and enabling real-time translational MPC. The translational controller employs adaptive model-fusion predictive control, combining constant-velocity and zero-velocity target models to accommodate different target-motion patterns. It updates the model weights using historical prediction errors and computes translational commands subject to actuation, following-distance, and field-of-view constraints. Through simulations and real-world experiments, we validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and show it has better performance than existing frameworks.

papers.title: Illusion of Depth: Revealing Hidden Stereo Vision Vulnerabilities in Depth Estimation
papers.abstract: Stereo cameras are integrated into autonomous systems such as self-driving cars, drones, and robots to offer precise depth estimation in a cost-effective manner compared to LiDAR technology. In this work, we reveal an intrinsic vulnerability in stereo cameras that stems from their pixel sampling and calibration processes, which can influence the outputs of stereo matching algorithms. Attackers can achieve fine-grained control over the estimated depth of real obstacles using simple repeating patterns, without relying on sophisticated adversarial machine learning techniques. Furthermore, deep learning-based depth estimation models exhibit a similar vulnerability. We evaluate the impact of this attack on two widely used stereo matching algorithms (BM and SGBM), three deep learning models (PSMNet, MoCha-Stereo, and UniMatch), a stereo-LiDAR fusion model (SGM-DDC), and two popular commercial stereo cameras, the ZED2 and Intel RealSense D435. For example, in the ZED2 camera, an attacker can displace obstacles up to 20~meters farther or 12~meters closer. In our real-world evaluation in a driving setting, a brief 0.5~second attack can trigger emergency braking in a popular autonomous driving framework. We further demonstrate the feasibility at driving speeds up to 40~km/h using CARLA. Finally, we confirm the ineffectiveness of state-of-the-art defenses, and we propose a novel strategy that leverages similarity scores to dynamically detect and suppress the depth discrepancies. Our work highlights vulnerabilities hidden in stereo matching and deep learning depth estimation models, addressing critical limitations in autonomous system deployments.

papers.abstract_zh: 立体相机被集成到自动驾驶汽车、无人机和机器人等自主系统中，与LiDAR技术相比，它能以经济高效的方式提供精确的深度估计。在本工作中，我们揭示了立体相机的一种内在脆弱性，该脆弱性源于其像素采样和标定过程，可能影响立体匹配算法的输出。攻击者无需依赖复杂的对抗性机器学习技术，仅使用简单的重复图案即可实现对真实障碍物估计深度的细粒度控制。此外，基于深度学习的深度估计模型也表现出类似的脆弱性。我们评估了该攻击对两种广泛使用的立体匹配算法（BM和SGBM）、三种深度学习模型（PSMNet、MoCha-Stereo和UniMatch）、一种立体-LiDAR融合模型（SGM-DDC）以及两款流行的商用立体相机ZED2和Intel RealSense D435的影响。例如，在ZED2相机中，攻击者可以将障碍物移远最多20米或移近最多12米。在驾驶场景中的真实世界评估中，一次持续0.5秒的短暂攻击即可触发一个流行自动驾驶框架中的紧急制动。我们进一步使用CARLA证明了在高达40公里/小时驾驶速度下的可行性。最后，我们确认了最先进防御方法的无效性，并提出了一种利用相似度分数动态检测并抑制深度差异的新策略。我们的工作凸显了立体匹配和深度学习深度估计模型中隐藏的脆弱性，解决了自主系统部署中的关键局限性。

papers.title: ScopeMamba-YOLO: Widening the Perceptual Scope Inward and Outward for Small Object Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery
papers.abstract: Small object detection in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and remote sensing imagery requires preserving high-resolution detail while modeling long-range context. Adding a stride-4 detection level and removing the stride-32 stage benefits tiny targets but weakens peripheral spatial support, whereas directly inserting selective scanning into the main feature path can interfere with weak local cues. We propose ScopeMamba-YOLO, built around an off-path, zero-gated selective-scanning principle that decouples contextual modeling from the convolutional stream. The principle is instantiated by a Cascaded Global-Context Module (CGCM) in the backbone and a Selective-Scan PAN (SS-PAN) in the neck. An Adaptive Multi-scale Strip (AMS) Block reduces the cost of high-resolution feature extraction, while a Scale-Adaptive DFL (SA-DFL) head reallocates distributional support and regression capacity across scales with only 0.008M additional parameters. Controlled experiments show that matched main-path selective scanning reduces mAP50 by 0.98 pp, whereas off-path CGCM improves the final configuration by 0.67 pp over the three-seed no-CGCM mean; operator controls indicate that this gain is not explained by auxiliary branch capacity alone. ERF analysis further shows that the complete context pathway increases the peripheral energy ratio from 0.008 to 0.090 at stride 8. On VisDrone-2019, ScopeMamba-S achieves 50.8% mAP50 with 3.57M parameters, exceeding YOLOv8s by 10.8 pp while using 32% of its parameters; ScopeMamba-M reaches 52.6% mAP50 with 6.48M parameters. Consistent improvements are also observed on AI-TOD, especially for very-tiny and tiny objects.

reserve_papers.abstract: Semantic communication (SemCom) and integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) are promising technologies for future 6G wireless networks. Existing studies have applied semantic technology to either the communication module or the sensing module of ISAC. In this work, we propose SemISAC, which performs both SemCom and semantic sensing within a single dual-function waveform. SemISAC uses a joint semantic encoder that extracts task-specific information for both communication and sensing. We evaluate SemISAC in a vehicular scenario in which vehicles share pixel-wise segmentation of the road environment and, through sensing, classify surrounding objects and estimate their ranges. On the transmitter side, a deep learning encoder converts the input road-scene image into semantic symbols and places them on the data cells of an OFDM grid, while the remaining cells serve as pilots for channel state information estimation and sensing. The pilot configuration is adaptively optimized based on the channel conditions to balance communication and sensing requirements. At the receiver, a deep learning model reconstructs the segmentation from the received waveform, while the transmitting vehicle captures the reflected waveforms from surrounding objects and uses task-specific deep learning decoders for target recognition and range estimation. Simulation results show that SemISAC achieves a segmentation accuracy close to that of the dedicated SemCom module while outperforming both conventional and semantic baselines in target recognition and range estimation.

reserve_papers.migration_zh: 研究推断：可将联合语义编码与自适应导频分配迁移至船舶视觉–AIS关联中的多传感器融合模块，以图像分割语义符号为输入、AIS标注为监督，并在融合前按信道质量调整导频与数据单元结构。
reserve_papers.abstract_zh: 语义通信（SemCom）与通感一体化（ISAC）是未来6G无线网络中有前景的技术。现有研究将语义技术应用于ISAC的通信模块或感知模块之一。在本工作中，我们提出SemISAC，它在单一双功能波形内同时执行SemCom与语义感知。SemISAC使用联合语义编码器提取面向通信与感知的任务特定信息。我们在车辆场景中评估SemISAC，其中车辆共享道路环境的像素级分割，并通过感知对周围物体进行分类并估计其距离。在发射端，深度学习编码器将输入的道路场景图像转换为语义符号，并将其放置在OFDM网格的数据单元上，而其余单元用作导频，用于信道状态信息估计与感知。导频配置根据信道条件自适应优化，以平衡通信与感知需求。在接收端，深度学习模型从接收波形重建分割，同时发射车辆捕获来自周围物体的反射波形，并使用任务特定的深度学习解码器进行目标识别与距离估计。仿真结果表明，SemISAC达到接近专用SemCom模块的分割精度，同时在目标识别与距离估计上优于传统基线和语义基线。

reserve_papers.title: Underwater Visual Target Tracking with Target-Specific Depth Estimation and Adaptive Model-Fusion Predictive Control
reserve_papers.abstract: Vision-based underwater target tracking is challenged by unreliable depth measurements and unknown target motion. This paper proposes a stereo visual-servoing framework for an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV). For perception, the framework derives a stable 3D relative state from stereo images through target-specific depth extraction and Kalman filtering. It constructs a target-depth mask from color, disparity, and temporal cues to select reliable target pixels, and then filters the resulting depth measurement and detected image center separately. For control, the framework decouples yaw regulation from translational control, avoiding computationally expensive coupled multi-DOF optimization and enabling real-time translational MPC. The translational controller employs adaptive model-fusion predictive control, combining constant-velocity and zero-velocity target models to accommodate different target-motion patterns. It updates the model weights using historical prediction errors and computes translational commands subject to actuation, following-distance, and field-of-view constraints. Through simulations and real-world experiments, we validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and show it has better performance than existing frameworks.
first_author_affiliations: Department of Automation , Shang- hai Jiao Tong University , Shanghai , China

reserve_papers.abstract_zh: 基于视觉的水下目标跟踪面临深度测量不可靠和目标运动未知的挑战。本文提出一种用于自主水下航行器（AUV）的立体视觉伺服框架。在感知方面，该框架通过目标特定深度提取和卡尔曼滤波，从立体图像中导出稳定的三维相对状态。它利用颜色、视差和时间线索构建目标深度掩码，以选择可靠的目标像素，然后分别对得到的深度测量值和检测到的图像中心进行滤波。在控制方面，该框架将偏航调节与平移控制解耦，避免计算代价高昂的耦合多自由度优化，并实现实时平移MPC。平移控制器采用自适应模型融合预测控制，结合匀速和零速目标模型以适应不同的目标运动模式。它利用历史预测误差更新模型权重，并在执行器、跟随距离和视场约束下计算平移指令。通过仿真和真实世界实验，我们验证了所提出框架的有效性，并表明其性能优于现有框架。

reserve_papers.title: Illusion of Depth: Revealing Hidden Stereo Vision Vulnerabilities in Depth Estimation
reserve_papers.abstract: Stereo cameras are integrated into autonomous systems such as self-driving cars, drones, and robots to offer precise depth estimation in a cost-effective manner compared to LiDAR technology. In this work, we reveal an intrinsic vulnerability in stereo cameras that stems from their pixel sampling and calibration processes, which can influence the outputs of stereo matching algorithms. Attackers can achieve fine-grained control over the estimated depth of real obstacles using simple repeating patterns, without relying on sophisticated adversarial machine learning techniques. Furthermore, deep learning-based depth estimation models exhibit a similar vulnerability. We evaluate the impact of this attack on two widely used stereo matching algorithms (BM and SGBM), three deep learning models (PSMNet, MoCha-Stereo, and UniMatch), a stereo-LiDAR fusion model (SGM-DDC), and two popular commercial stereo cameras, the ZED2 and Intel RealSense D435. For example, in the ZED2 camera, an attacker can displace obstacles up to 20~meters farther or 12~meters closer. In our real-world evaluation in a driving setting, a brief 0.5~second attack can trigger emergency braking in a popular autonomous driving framework. We further demonstrate the feasibility at driving speeds up to 40~km/h using CARLA. Finally, we confirm the ineffectiveness of state-of-the-art defenses, and we propose a novel strategy that leverages similarity scores to dynamically detect and suppress the depth discrepancies. Our work highlights vulnerabilities hidden in stereo matching and deep learning depth estimation models, addressing critical limitations in autonomous system deployments.

reserve_papers.summary_zh: 该论文揭示立体相机因像素采样与标定过程在立体匹配和深度学习深度估计中存在的内在漏洞，用简单重复图案即可精细操控障碍物深度，并在多种算法、模型、融合方案和商用相机上评估其影响，进而提出基于相似度分数的检测抑制策略。
reserve_papers.migration_zh: 研究推断：可将重复纹理诱导的深度偏差检测模块迁移至视觉深度估计与Radar–AIS或视觉–AIS关联前端，以相似度分数或跨模态一致性作为无监督监督信号，在融合前增加深度合理性校验与抑制分支。
reserve_papers.abstract_zh: 立体相机被集成到自动驾驶汽车、无人机和机器人等自主系统中，与LiDAR技术相比，它能以经济高效的方式提供精确的深度估计。在本工作中，我们揭示了立体相机的一种内在脆弱性，该脆弱性源于其像素采样和标定过程，可能影响立体匹配算法的输出。攻击者无需依赖复杂的对抗性机器学习技术，仅使用简单的重复图案即可实现对真实障碍物估计深度的细粒度控制。此外，基于深度学习的深度估计模型也表现出类似的脆弱性。我们评估了该攻击对两种广泛使用的立体匹配算法（BM和SGBM）、三种深度学习模型（PSMNet、MoCha-Stereo和UniMatch）、一种立体-LiDAR融合模型（SGM-DDC）以及两款流行的商用立体相机ZED2和Intel RealSense D435的影响。例如，在ZED2相机中，攻击者可以将障碍物移远最多20米或移近最多12米。在驾驶场景中的真实世界评估中，一次持续0.5秒的短暂攻击即可触发一个流行自动驾驶框架中的紧急制动。我们进一步使用CARLA证明了在高达40公里/小时驾驶速度下的可行性。最后，我们确认了最先进防御方法的无效性，并提出了一种利用相似度分数动态检测并抑制深度差异的新策略。我们的工作凸显了立体匹配和深度学习深度估计模型中隐藏的脆弱性，解决了自主系统部署中的关键局限性。

reserve_papers.title: ScopeMamba-YOLO: Widening the Perceptual Scope Inward and Outward for Small Object Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery
reserve_papers.abstract: Small object detection in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and remote sensing imagery requires preserving high-resolution detail while modeling long-range context. Adding a stride-4 detection level and removing the stride-32 stage benefits tiny targets but weakens peripheral spatial support, whereas directly inserting selective scanning into the main feature path can interfere with weak local cues. We propose ScopeMamba-YOLO, built around an off-path, zero-gated selective-scanning principle that decouples contextual modeling from the convolutional stream. The principle is instantiated by a Cascaded Global-Context Module (CGCM) in the backbone and a Selective-Scan PAN (SS-PAN) in the neck. An Adaptive Multi-scale Strip (AMS) Block reduces the cost of high-resolution feature extraction, while a Scale-Adaptive DFL (SA-DFL) head reallocates distributional support and regression capacity across scales with only 0.008M additional parameters. Controlled experiments show that matched main-path selective scanning reduces mAP50 by 0.98 pp, whereas off-path CGCM improves the final configuration by 0.67 pp over the three-seed no-CGCM mean; operator controls indicate that this gain is not explained by auxiliary branch capacity alone. ERF analysis further shows that the complete context pathway increases the peripheral energy ratio from 0.008 to 0.090 at stride 8. On VisDrone-2019, ScopeMamba-S achieves 50.8% mAP50 with 3.57M parameters, exceeding YOLOv8s by 10.8 pp while using 32% of its parameters; ScopeMamba-M reaches 52.6% mAP50 with 6.48M parameters. Consistent improvements are also observed on AI-TOD, especially for very-tiny and tiny objects.

reserve_papers.summary_zh: 论文针对无人机与遥感图像中小目标检测需兼顾高分辨率细节与长程上下文的问题，提出ScopeMamba-YOLO，通过离路零门控选择性扫描原则解耦上下文建模与卷积流，并实例化为CGCM与SS-PAN，在VisDrone-2019和AI-TOD上显著提升小目标检测性能。
reserve_papers.migration_zh: 研究推断：可将离路零门控选择性扫描与CGCM模块迁移至船舶检测/分割网络中，以额外分支输入多尺度特征并施加门控监督，在不干扰主卷积流的前提下增强远海小目标的长程上下文与边缘细节。
reserve_papers.abstract_zh: 无人机（UAV）和遥感图像中的小目标检测需要在建模长程上下文的同时保留高分辨率细节。增加步长4的检测层并移除步长32阶段有利于微小目标，但会削弱外围空间支撑；而直接将选择性扫描插入主特征路径可能干扰微弱的局部线索。我们提出ScopeMamba-YOLO，其核心是离路、零门控的选择性扫描原则，将上下文建模与卷积流解耦。该原则由骨干网络中的级联全局上下文模块（CGCM）和颈部中的选择性扫描PAN（SS-PAN）实例化。自适应多尺度条带（AMS）块降低了高分辨率特征提取的成本，而尺度自适应DFL（SA-DFL）头仅以0.008M额外参数重新分配跨尺度的分布支撑和回归能力。控制实验表明，匹配的主路径选择性扫描使mAP50降低0.98个百分点，而离路CGCM使最终配置相比三次种子无CGCM均值提升0.67个百分点；算子控制表明该增益不能仅由辅助分支容量解释。ERF分析进一步表明，完整上下文通路在步长8处将外围能量比从0.008提高到0.090。在VisDrone-2019上，ScopeMamba-S以3.57M参数达到50.8% mAP50，超过YOLOv8s 10.8个百分点，而参数量仅为其32%；ScopeMamba-M以6.48M参数达到52.6% mAP50。在AI-TOD上也观察到一致改进，尤其是对极微小和微小目标。
